newsitem.title: USA: Molex Inc board approves share repurchase.
newsitem.headline: Molex Inc board approves share repurchase.

text.p: Molex Inc said Monday its board of directors has renewed its authorization for the repurchase of up to $50 million in its common stock.
The authorization for discretionary purchases runs through June 30, 1998, the eelctronic components company said.
During the fiscal year ended June 30, 1997, the company purchased about 1.1 million shares of the company's outstanding common stock with a total purchase value of about $31.9 million.
The number of shares of stock purchased during fiscal 1998, if any, will depend upon various factors including the relative price of the stock, the company said.
Molex shares were up 1/2 at 40 Monday, the company said.
